evidence_inputs: The identity rescope is correct on its own terms: measure.py:408 _polygonanalytic_source resolves Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / POLYGONANALYTIC_SOURCE to the repository's nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py, and measure.py:420 hashes it with coupling_build.__file__; identity-refusal.log shows the pre-repair kernel (digest 14573967e239d850) and HEAD (0425598d0de19a99) produce distinct builder_revisions, so an old-kernel carrier is a different carrier.

The 1e-12 floor is met on eight of nine coupling blocks and missed on one: requalify-carriers.json limited:5000 worst_block plasma_to_sample_r 1.2186816095922636e-12, within_tolerance false; the block carries the rung's headline, so done-when(2)'s 'within 1e-12 norm-relative on every block' is unmet and the fragment states this plainly rather than rounding it.

Coverage of done-when(2)/(3) is partial and honestly recorded: only limited:5000 has a host-against-device agreement (diverted:5000 hit job 1284903's 01:15:00 limit while assembling the diverted carrier); the 10,000-cell rung was built on the device builder only (job 1284803, wall 3,209.5846427511424 s, store 3,526,603,966 bytes) and its diverted case is refused at stencil conditioning ring 475/cell 535 condition 1.758e+03, so no 10,000 agreement and no diverted 10,000 row exist.

The attribution (done-when 4) is delivered by measurement, not bisect: all three named revisions read 0.1973269787169759, and two further revisions (8fe66e390, c3c95a467) and a bracketing pair (1b68b8099, f68870f99) locate the mover at f68870f99, the exterior exact-support merge -- an intended accuracy change, value stable to 1.2e-16 after it.

scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/requalify_carriers.py:52 _relative is a symmetric norm-relative (max|a-b| / max(max|a|, max|b|, tiny)), which is the measure done-when(2) names; it is not the pointwise relative_sup at scripts/ring_attribution/localize_support_limit.py:112.
